blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on visual reasoning tasks, yet remain prone to hallucinations and over-reliance on language priors, often generating answers without adequately using task-relevant visual evidence. Existing approaches primarily improve reasoning through reasoning-oriented supervision or inference-time strategies. In this work, we study a complementary question: can multimodal reasoning be improved by strengthening implicit visual grounding without directly supervising the reasoning process? Motivated by the functional specialization of attention heads, we investigate whether reasoning can be improved by guiding only the heads most responsive to visual evidence grounding. We propose Selective Probability Mass Concentration (sPMC), a training framework that identifies grounding-responsive heads and selectively regularizes their text-to-image attention. sPMC treats normalized attention over visual tokens as a spatial probability distribution and encourages the probability mass to be assigned to semantically relevant regions using segmentation-derived spatial priors. Adaptive Head Selection restricts this guidance to visually responsive heads while leaving the remaining heads unconstrained to preserve their complementary functions. Across 6 multimodal benchmark suites, sPMC achieves an average zero-shot improvement of 3% and gains of up to 11.3% across multiple MLLMs while regularizing only 3%-15% of their attention heads. These results demonstrate that targeted guidance of sparse and implicit visual evidence pathways can directly improve multimodal reasoning.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)在视觉推理任务上取得了强大的性能,然而仍然容易产生幻觉,过度依赖语言前传,往往产生答案,而没有充分利用与任务相关的视觉证据. 现有办法主要通过注重推理的监督或推断时间战略改进推理。 在这项工作中,我们研究了一个补充性问题:能否通过加强隐含的视觉基础而不直接监督推理过程来改进多式联运推理? 受关注头的功能专业化的驱使,我们调查是否可以通过指导那些对视觉证据基础反应最迅速的头来改进推理。 我们提议选择概率质量集中(spMC),这是一个培训框架,它确定地面响应头,并有选择地规范其文字到图像的注意力。 SPMC将常态化的对视觉信号的注意作为空间概率分布,并鼓励利用分化衍生的空间前兆,将概率质量分配给与分解相关的区域。 适应性头部选择将这一指导限制在视效头部,同时使其余头部不受限制,以保持其互补功能。 在6个多模式基准套件中,SPMC平均实现3%的零镜头改进,多个MLLM的增益高达11.3%,而只规范了3%-15%的注意力头. 这些结果表明,有针对性地指导稀少和隐含的视觉证据路径可直接改进多式联运推理。

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) ( Bai et al. 2023 ; Dai et al. 2023 ; Team 2024 ) have made substantial progress on visually grounded reasoning tasks, including Visual Question Answering (VQA) ( Li et al. 2025b ; Gao et al. 2025 ; Deng et al. 2025 ) . Nevertheless, they remain prone to hallucinations and over-reliance on language priors ( Leng et al. 2024 ; Bai et al. 2024 ) , often producing answers without adequately using task-relevant visual evidence. This problem is especially acute in fine-grained reasoning, where a correct answer may depend on only a few informative visual cues.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)(Bai等人) 2023; 戴等人编. 2023; Team 2024)在视觉基于推理任务上取得了实质性进展,包括视觉问答(VQA)(Li等人. 2025b; Gao等人著。 2025; 邓等 2025). 尽管如此,她们仍然容易产生幻觉,过度依赖语言前科(Leng等人)。 2024 ; Bai 等人 2024 ),经常在未充分利用与任务相关的视觉证据的情况下生成答案. 这个问题在精细的推理中特别尖锐,在推理中,正确的答案可能只取决于几个信息丰富的视觉提示.

blocks.en: Recent analyses associate these failures with misallocated text-to-image attention ( Seil et al. 2025 ; Woo et al. 2025 ; Chen et al. 2025 ) . Attention determines which visual signals are emphasized and propagated during decoding; when it is diffuse or concentrated on irrelevant regions, the model may aggregate incomplete or misleading evidence. These findings suggest that reasoning failures are often linked not only to deficiencies in reasoning itself, but also to ineffective utilization of visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 最近的分析将这些失败与文字到图像的注意力分配不当联系起来(Seil等人)。 2025; Woo et al. 2025; 陈等 2025). 注意度决定了在解码过程中哪些视觉信号被强调和传播;当其扩散或集中在无关区域时,模型可能会汇总不完整或误导性的证据. 这些调查结果表明,推理失败不仅往往与推理本身的缺陷有关,而且与视觉证据的无效利用有关。

blocks.en: Existing methods therefore attempt to improve visual grounding either by manipulating attention dynamics during inference ( Seil et al. 2025 ; Woo et al. 2025 ; Leng et al. 2024 ) or by directly aligning attention maps during training ( Chen et al. 2025 ) . While inference-time approaches can partially mitigate attention misallocation, they operate on the model’s native attention dynamics and do not fundamentally improve how visual evidence is utilized. Training-based approaches provide stronger supervision signals, but rigidly assume dense alignment across attention maps, requiring broad modification of the attention mechanism. Despite their methodological differences, both paradigms implicitly treat attention as a uniformly important component. Recent work suggests that visual grounding is concentrated in a small subset of attention heads ( Seil et al. 2025 ; Kang et al. 2025 ) . This raises a unexplored question: can multimodal reasoning be improved by selectively strengthening the attention pathways exhibiting strong visual-grounding signals, rather than directly the reasoning process itself?
blocks.zh: 因此,现有方法试图通过在推论中操纵注意力动态来改进视觉定位(Seil等人,第19段)。 2025; Woo et al. 2025; Leng等人 2024)或通过在训练中直接对齐关注地图(Chen等人 2025). 虽然推断时间办法可以部分减轻注意力分配不当,但它们在模型的本土注意力动态上运作,并不能从根本上改善视觉证据的利用。 以培训为基础的方法提供了更强有力的监督信号,但僵硬地假定各关注地图之间密不可分,需要广泛修改关注机制。 尽管在方法上存在差异,但这两种范式都含蓄地将注意力视为一个统一的重要组成部分。 近期的研究表明,视觉定位集中在少数关注头(Seil等人)。 2025; Kang等人著. 2025). 这提出了一个未加探讨的问题:能否通过有选择地加强显示强烈视觉定位信号的注意力路径,而不是直接通过推理过程本身来改进多式联运推理?

blocks.en: In response, we propose Selective Probability Mass Concentration (sPMC) , a training framework for targeted text-to-image attention guidance. Given a segmentation-derived spatial mask, sPMC increases the total attention mass assigned to the masked region without prescribing its distribution across individual visual tokens. Because the objective constrains only aggregate in-mask mass, it tolerates moderately over-inclusive masks without requiring every masked token to match a fixed target. Through a head-level empirical study, we confirm that strong visual engagement and spatial grounding are consistently concentrated in a small subset of attention heads. Building on this finding, Adaptive Head Selection applies sPMC only through these grounding-responsive heads while leaving the remaining heads unconstrained. Controlled ablations further show that guiding this subset yields consistent improvements in downstream reasoning and is more effective than all-head guidance. This observation suggests that effective visual evidence utilization is not uniformly distributed throughout the attention mechanism. Instead, a relatively small number of attention heads appear to form attention pathways that exhibit particularly strong visual-grounding behavior. Our contributions are:
blocks.zh: 作为回应,我们提出选择性概率质量集中(spMC),作为有针对性的文本到图像关注指导的培训框架。 由于分化衍生的空间面具,SPMC增加了分配给蒙蔽区域的总注意力质量,而没有规定其在单个视觉标志上的分布. 由于目标只制约总和的面具质量,因此它能容忍中等程度的过于包容的面具,而不要求每个蒙面标志物匹配固定的目标. 通过头级经验研究,我们确认,强烈的视觉接触和空间定位一直集中在一小部分关注头。 基于这一发现,适应性头部选择只通过这些地面反应头部应用SPMC,同时使其余头部不受限制. 受控制的浮雕进一步表明,引导这一子集在下游推理方面产生一致的改进,比全头指导更有效. 这一看法表明,有效的视觉证据利用没有在整个关注机制中统一分布。 相反,相对较少的注意力头似乎形成注意力路径,表现出特别强烈的视觉定位行为. 我们的贡献是:

blocks.en: Related Work
blocks.zh: 有关工作

blocks.en: Multimodal Large Language Models
blocks.zh: 多式联运大型语文模式

blocks.en: MLLMs such as Qwen-VL ( Bai et al. 2023 ) , InstructBLIP ( Dai et al. 2023 ) , and LLaVA ( Liu et al. 2024 ) achieve strong performance across multimodal tasks ( Li et al. 2019 ; Deng et al. 2025 ) . Many architectures connect a pretrained vision encoder, such as ViT ( Dosovitskiy et al. 2020 ) , to a language model through a learned adapter. Decoder-only models such as Chameleon ( Team 2024 ) and Qwen3-VL ( Bai et al. 2025 ) instead represent visual and textual inputs in a shared autoregressive sequence. In both designs, attention provides an important interface between queries and visual tokens, making it a natural target for grounding supervision.
blocks.zh: 诸如Quen-VL(Bai等人,2023年),IstructBLIP(Dai等人,2023年),LLAVA(Liu等人,2024年)等MLLMs在多式联运任务中取得了强劲的业绩(Li等人,2023年). 2019; 邓等 2025). 许多建筑通过学习的适配器将一个预先训练的视觉编码器,如VIT(Dosovitskiy et al. 2020)与语言模型连接起来. 解码器唯一的模型,如Chameleon(Team 2024)和Qune3-VL(Bai et al. 2025),而是在共享的自递序列中代表视觉和文字输入. 在这两种设计中,注意力都提供了查询和视觉符号的重要接口,使其成为地面监督的自然目标.

blocks.en: Enhancing Multimodal Reasoning
blocks.zh: 加强多式联运的理由

blocks.en: Recent efforts to enhance multimodal reasoning in MLLMs largely focus on improving intermediate reasoning processes and grounding mechanisms to alleviate multimodal hallucinations. A prominent direction comprises Multimodal Chain-of-Thought (MCoT) methods ( Zhang et al. 2024 ; Gao et al. 2025 ; Wu et al. 2024 ) , which extend the success of CoT prompting in LLMs to multimodal settings by introducing explicit intermediate reasoning steps ( Zheng et al. 2023 ; Chen et al. 2024b ; Zhang et al. 2024 ; Mitra et al. 2024 ) . ICoT ( Gao et al. 2025 ) , for example, interleaves visual regions selected using attention scores, while MVoT ( Li et al. 2025a ) pairs intermediate reasoning steps with generated visualizations. Such methods improve the reasoning process but may still inherit errors from the mechanism used to select visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 最近加强多式联运和微型企业中心多式联运推理的努力主要侧重于改进中间推理程序和基础机制,以缓解多式联运的幻觉。 一个突出的方向是多种思维链方法(Zhang等人)。 2024; Gao et al. 2025;Wu等人 2024),通过引入明确的中间推理步骤,将CoT在LLMs中激发的成功扩展到了多式联运设置(Zheng等人. 2023; 陈等. 2024b; 张等. 2024; Mitra et al. 2024 ). 例如,ICoT(Gao et al. 2025),使用注意力分数选择的互页视觉区域,而MVoT(Li et al. 2025a)则将中间推理步骤与生成的可视化对齐. 这种方法改进了推理过程,但仍可能继承用于选择视觉证据的机制的错误.

blocks.en: Another line of studies has identified cross-modal attention misallocation as a key factor contributing to the failure of visual reasoning tasks ( Seil et al. 2025 ; Woo et al. 2025 ; Chen et al. 2025 ) . These works show that attention maps are often either overly diffuse or concentrated on irrelevant regions, leading to ineffective aggregation of visual evidence during reasoning. To address this issue, several approaches attempt to rectify attention by manipulating attention distributions. For instance, ( Seil et al. 2025 ) applies diagnostic experiment to identify attention heads that consistently attend to irrelevant patches (attention sinks). They then propose an inference-time intervention that reallocates attention away from these sinks. ( Leng et al. 2024 ) introduces contrastive decoding adjustments to refine attention allocation. Lavender ( Chen et al. 2025 ) enables MLLMs to learn towards diffusion’s attention maps through patch-wise regression. While these techniques can partially improve visual perception by redistributing attention, their effectiveness is inherently limited, often yielding modest improvements and incurring additional inference overhead. Also, they fail to directly learn how attention is distributed across visual tokens.
blocks.zh: 另一行研究将跨模式注意力错位确定为导致视觉推理任务失败的关键因素(Seil等人. 2025; Woo et al. 2025; 陈等 2025). 这些作品表明,关注地图往往过于分散或集中在无关地区,导致推理过程中视觉证据的集成无效. 为解决这一问题,若干办法试图通过操纵注意力分配来纠正注意力。 例如,(Seil等人,2025年)运用诊断实验来确定始终注意不相关的补丁(注意汇)的注意力头。 然后,它们提出一种推断时间干预,将注意力从这些汇中重新分配。 (Leng等人,2024年)引入对比解码调整,以完善注意力分配. Lavender(Chen等人,2025年)使MLLMs能够通过补丁回归来学习传播的注意力图. 虽然这些技术通过重新分配注意力可以部分改善视觉感知,但其效力本身是有限的,往往略有改进,并引起额外的推断间接费用。 此外,他们未能直接了解注意力如何在视觉符号上分配。

blocks.en: Methodology
blocks.zh: 方法

blocks.en: We propose a novel supervision framework to improve MLLMs’ general reasoning abilities by explicitly regularizing their spatial attention distribution. Built on the hypothesis that effective reasoning depends on concentrating attention over semantically relevant image regions, we first construct semantically enriched grounding masks using external segmentation priors. We then selectively identify attention heads that exhibit strong grounding behavior and aggregate multi-head, multi-layer attention into a unified spatial representation. Finally, we introduce a probability mass concentration objective that encourages the model to allocate more attention to relevant regions while preserving their pretrained generative capabilities. Together, these components provide a weakly supervised yet effective framework for aligning textual queries with visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 我们建议建立一个新的监督框架,通过明确规范它们的空间注意力分布,提高MLLMs的一般推理能力。 我们基于一个假设,即有效的推理取决于将注意力集中在与映像相关的区域之上,我们首先利用外部分解前缀构建精密浓缩的地面口罩。 然后,我们有选择地确定显示强烈地面行为的注意力头,将多头、多层次的注意力集中到一个统一的空间代表中。 最后,我们提出了一个概率质量集中目标,鼓励该模式在保持相关区域事先受过训练的基因能力的同时,更多地关注相关区域。 这些组成部分加在一起,为将文字查询与视觉证据相协调提供了一个受到薄弱监督但有效的框架。

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 Semantically Enriched Grounding Mask Generation
blocks.zh: 算法 1 语义上丰富的地表面具

blocks.en: Semantically Enriched Grounding Masks
blocks.zh: 语义上丰富的地面面具

blocks.en: Dense attention annotations are rarely available at scale, so we derive weak spatial priors using SAM 3 ( Carion et al. 2026 ) , which is designed to detect and segment visual concepts specified by short noun-phrase prompts.
blocks.zh: 注意注意说明很少在尺度上提供,因此我们利用SAM 3(Carion et al. 2026)来得出微弱的空间前兆,该说明旨在检测和分解短名词提示指定的视觉概念.

blocks.en: Given an image, we prompt pre-trained LLMs to derive several semantically enriched text proposals by extracting noun phrases with language modifiers (e.g., color, size and locations) from captions or input context. The textual proposals specify not only object categories but also identifiable fine-grained properties that refer to a particular instance, such as “man wearing green shirt” or “dog on the left” . For caption-based samples, proposals are extracted from image-associated captions; for VQA samples, they are extracted from reference answers. We retain only concrete noun phrases that denote visually localizable entities. Because these source texts describe the corresponding image, this construction reduces the likelihood that a segmentation prompt refers to an absent concept.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个图像,我们通过从标题或输入语境中提取带有语言修饰符的名词短语(例如颜色、大小和位置),来促使预先训练的LLMs从几个精密充实的文本提案中得出. 案文提案不仅具体规定了物体类别,而且指明了可识别的细纹属性,这些属性是指某一具体实例,如“穿绿色衬衫的人”或“左边的狗”。 对于基于标题的样本,从图像相关标题中提取建议;对于VQA样本,从参考答案中提取建议. 我们只保留具体名词短语,表示可视化的本地实体。 因为这些源文本描述了相应的图像,这种构造降低了一个分解提示指一个缺失的概念的可能性.

blocks.en:
Conditioned on each proposal, SAM generates multiple candidate regions corresponding to different visual hypotheses. We then aggregate these segmentation masks into a single binary mask and discard masks with excessively large foreground ratio (>60%) to avoid coarse or non-informative coverage.
The resulting masks ℳ i , j ∈ { 0 , 1 } \mathcal{M}_{i,j}\in\{0,1\} capture semantically relevant regions corresponding to the noun phrase, which serve as region-level priors that guide text-to-image attention toward relevant areas, without enforcing overly strict supervision. Implementation details can be found in the Appendix and Algorithm 1 . We treat the resulting masks as weak spatial priors rather than pixel-accurate ground truth. Merging candidate masks improves coverage, while the foreground-area filter removes overly broad masks. This favors recall because sPMC is more robust to moderate over-coverage than to missing relevant regions.

blocks.en:
Our method is evaluated across six benchmark suites, reported as seven evaluation sets, grouped into two categories: general vision-language understanding and hallucination evaluation. 1) General vision-language understanding task assesses comprehensive multimodal capabilities such as OCR and reasoning. We include four benchmarks under this category, including MMVP ( Tong et al. 2024 ) , VisOnly (Synthetic and Real splits) ( Kamoi et al. 2025 ) , V* ( Wu and Xie 2023 ) and MME ( Fu et al. 2025 ) .
2) hallucination evaluation includes POPE ( Li et al. 2023 ) and HallusionBench ( Guan et al. 2024 ) , two specialized benchmarks designed to assess whether a model’s responses remain faithful to the input image, thereby evaluating its reliability.

blocks.en: Main Results
blocks.zh: 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1 presents a comprehensive comparison of zero-shot performance across multiple multimodal benchmarks under varying model scales and training regimes. Results demonstrate that the proposed method brings consistent performance improvements and reduced hallucination.
blocks.zh: 表1全面比较了不同示范规模和培训制度下的多种多式联运基准的零射效绩。 结果表明,拟议方法带来一贯的性能改进和减少幻觉。

blocks.en:
The results show that the proposed sPMC drives consistent performance gains on various baseline models across multiple benchmarks (on average 2.1%-3.7% depending on the base model).
In particular, our proposed sPMC elevates Qwen3 - VL - 8B over existing state - of - the - art performance, surpassing larger models such as GPT - 4V and Gemini 1.5 Pro on HallusionBench (59.5) and MMVP (69.3), despite being 7× smaller. This demonstrates that our method enables lightweight models to outperform their nominal capacity.
sPMC shows a specialized strength in reducing model hallucination. On two specialized hallucination challenges POPE and HallusionBench, our method yields average relative gains of 0.7% and 4.5% performance gains respectively to various base models, which verifies our theoretical hypothesis that better attention distribution can help alleviate MLLMs’ hallucination.
blocks.zh:
结果显示,拟议的方案、监测和评价委员会推动各种基准模型在多个基准上取得一致的业绩收益(根据基准模型,平均2.1%-3.7%)。
特别是,我们提议的SPMC将Qune3 - VL - 8B提升到艺术表演的现有状态之上,超越了更大的模型,例如GPT - 4V和Halluusion Bench上的双子座1.5 Pro(59.5)和MMVP(69.3),尽管其规模是7×x。 这表明,我们的方法使轻量级模型能够超过其名义容量。
SPMC在减少模型幻觉方面表现出了专门的力量. 在POPE和Halusion Bench的两个特殊幻觉挑战上,我们的方法对各种基本模型分别得出了0.7%和4.5%的相对效果收益,这验证了我们的理论假设,即更好的注意力分布有助于缓解MLLMs的幻觉。

blocks.en: Effective selection of visual grounding attention heads. Table 2 and the two leftmost plots in Figure 3 reveal a consistent pattern in attention - head selection across both decoder - only and cross - attention architectures. In all cases, only a small subset of heads is repeatedly selected, with selection rates ranging from 3.03% to 15.4%, indicating that visual grounding is highly sparse and concentrated in a limited number of heads. This sparsity is especially pronounced in larger models such as Qwen3 - VL - 8B, where only 3% of heads are identified as relevant. Additionally, the decoder-only architecture rely only on self-attention mechanism, which entangles perception and reasoning within unified attention heads. This structural entanglement makes text-to-image attention guidance even more challenging for these more modern decoder-only models ( Chen et al. 2025 ) . Subsequently, it highlights the inherent significance of identifying grounding-relevant heads, as the results support restricting the alignment loss to heads most strongly associated with visual grounding. These observations motivate our design choice: instead of supervising all attention heads indiscriminately, focusing on a small subset of grounding-relevant heads enables more efficient and precise supervision. This insight underpins the proposed Adaptive Head Selection strategy.
blocks.zh: 有效选择视觉定位注意力头. 图3中的表2和两个最左侧的地块显示了注意的一贯规律——头部选择横跨了解码器——只有和交叉的注意结构. 在所有情况下,只反复选取少量头部,选取率从3.03%到15.4%不等,表明视觉地面高度稀少,集中在数量有限的头部. 这种痉挛现象在较大的模型中特别突出,如Qune3 - VL - 8B,只有3%的头被确定为相关. 此外,只有解码器的架构只依靠自留心机制,这种机制将感知和推理缠绕在统一注意力头之内. 这种结构缠绕使得文本到图像的注意指导对于这些更现代的解码器唯一的模型(Chen等人,2025年)更加具有挑战性. 随后,报告强调了确定与地基有关的头部的内在重要性,因为成果支持将对齐损失限制在与目视地面最密切相关的头部。 这些观察促使我们作出设计选择:而不是不加区别地监督所有关注的负责人,而侧重于少数与地面相关的负责人,能够提高监督的效率和准确性。 这一见解是拟议调整型头部选择战略的基础。

blocks.en: More grounded text-to-image attention. The two rightmost plots in Figure 3 , which compare cross - modal attention before and after applying sPMC, provide further evidence of the method’s effectiveness. After application of sPMC, the global distribution of text-to-image attention remains largely stable, with only a slight reduction in total attention mass, indicating that the model does not simply suppress attention. In contrast, the alignment loss decreases substantially, showing that the model reallocates attention toward task - critical visual evidence. Together, these results demonstrate that sPMC sharpens text - to - image attention by preserving overall attention behavior while redirecting focus away from irrelevant regions and toward the correct visual cues.
blocks.zh: 更多基于文字到图像的注意. 图3中最右侧的两幅图比较了应用SPMC之前和之后的交叉式注意,进一步证明了该方法的有效性。 在SPMC应用后,文字对图像关注的全球分布基本保持稳定,只略微减少了总关注质量,表明该模型并不只是压制关注. 与此相反,对齐损失大幅减少,表明模型将注意力重新分配到任务上——关键的视觉证据。 这些结果表明,SPMC通过保持整体关注行为,同时将注意力从无关区域转向正确的视觉提示,使文字对图像的注意更加突出。

blocks.zh: 适应性头部选择

blocks.en: To evaluate Adaptive Head Selection, we compare Adaptive-Late with four variants: aggregation over all heads ( All Heads ), random selection from late layers ( Random-Late ), adaptive selection from early layers ( Adaptive-Early ), and adaptive selection across all layers ( Adaptive-Full ). All adaptive variants use the head selection criteria; Adaptive-Late applies them to layers 17–28.
blocks.zh: 为了评价适应性头部选择,我们将适应-Late与四个变体进行比较:所有头(所有头)的集合,后层的随机选择(随机-Late),早期层的适应性选择(适应-Early),以及所有层的适应性选择(适应-Full). 所有适应性变体都使用头部选择标准;适应-Late将其应用于第17–28层.

blocks.en: Late-layer guidance is more effective. As shown in Figure 4 , Adaptive-Late achieves the best performance across all five evaluation metrics. All Heads trails it by 6.24% on average, indicating that indiscriminate regularization can dilute grounding-relevant signals. Random-Late is 3.9 points lower despite using the same layer range, showing that the gains depend on which heads are selected rather than merely on reducing their number. Layer placement is also important: Adaptive-Early trails Adaptive-Late by approximately 10 points, while Adaptive-Full improves upon Adaptive-Early by 4.9 points but remains inferior to late-layer selection. Together, these results support applying sPMC to adaptively selected grounding-responsive heads in later layers.
blocks.zh: 晚期指导更为有效。 如图4所示,适应时间在所有五个评价指标中都取得了最佳业绩。 所有头部平均跟踪6.24%,表明不分青红皂白的正规化可淡化地面相关信号。 尽管采用了相同的层域,随机-late还是降低了3.9分,这表明收益取决于选择哪一个头,而不仅仅是减少头数. 层层布置也很重要:适应-耳径(Adapitive-Early rails) 适应-Late(Adapitive-Late)的分数约为10分,而适应-耳径(Adapitive-Full)在Adapitive-Early(Adapitive-Early)的分数上改进了4.9分,但仍然低于后期的选取. 这些成果共同支持在后几层采用SMMC来适应性地选择地面响应头.

blocks.en: Training objective variants
blocks.zh: 培训目标变式

blocks.en:
We compare sPMC with the pretrained model without fine-tuning ( No Guidance ), autoregressive LoRA fine-tuning ( AutoR. ), and patch-wise cross-entropy alignment with the normalized mask ( Cross-Entropy ).
The choice of alignment objective is critical. As shown in Table 3 , AutoR. and Cross-Entropy reduce average zero-shot performance by 3.03% and 9.42%, respectively, relative to the pretrained model. The larger degradation from Cross-Entropy indicates that exact patch-wise alignment imposes an overly restrictive attention target. In contrast, sPMC improves performance, supporting the use of flexible region-level probability-mass guidance over point-wise matching.
blocks.zh:
我们比较SPMC与未微调(无引导)的预训模型,自旋式LORA微调(AutoR.),以及补丁-顺理成章的交叉对调与正态的面具(cross-Entropy.).
调整目标的选择至关重要。 如表3所示,AutoR.和Cross-Entropy相对预训型号分别将平均零发性能降低3.03%和9.42%. 来自Cross-Entropy的更大降解表明,精确的补丁对齐给关注目标带来了过度的限制. 相比之下,SPMC提高了性能,支持使用灵活的地区级概率质量指导而不是点位匹配.

blocks.en: Qualitative analysis
blocks.zh: 定性分析

blocks.en:
We also present multiple qualitative examples in Figure 5 . Across the presented examples, the performance gains are evident over various multimodal tasks, spanning from graphic/diagram interpretation ( Chubb illusion and Central bank examples), OCR-intensive text understanding (the question about Abraham
Lincoln’s quote ) to commonsense reasoning, and fine-grained visual-grounded discrimination. These improvements verify our method’s ability to steer attention toward task-relevant regions, thereby improving access to relevant visual evidence and reducing hallucination.
blocks.zh:
我们还在图5中提出了多个定性实例。 在所介绍的事例中,从图形/图表解释(Chubb幻觉和中央银行实例)、OCR密集型文本理解(关于亚伯拉罕的问题)等各种多式联运任务中可以明显看出绩效收益。
Lincoln的引文)为常识推理, 这些改进验证了我们把注意力引向与任务相关的区域的能力,从而改进了获取相关视觉证据的机会并减少了幻觉。

blocks.en: An illustrative example in the top-right corner further highlights this advantage: the sPMC-tuned model demonstrates stronger alignment between salient visual evidence and generated responses, particularly in scenarios where critical cues are subtle or easily overlooked (e.g., the lady in the corner is carrying a handbag. ). By concentrating probability mass on relevant regions, the model is better at capturing fine-grained details that are essential for accurate reasoning.
blocks.zh: 右上角的一个示例进一步突出了这一优势:SPMC调制模型显示显著的视觉证据和产生的响应之间更加一致,特别是在关键提示微妙或容易被忽略的情景中(例如,角上的女士手提包。 通过将概率质量集中在相关区域,该模型能够更好地捕捉对准确推理至关重要的精细细节。

blocks.en: However, the bottom-left example highlights a representative failure case: when task-relevant evidence is very ambiguous (e.g., a blurred pet bed in the background ), our model may under-attend to such low-saliency regions and fail to recover the correct answer. This suggests that while attention concentration improves robustness in most settings, it may also bias the model against weak signals, indicating a limitation in handling uncertain visual details.
blocks.zh: 然而,左下方的例子突出了一个具有代表性的失败案例:当与任务相关的证据非常模糊(例如背景中一个模糊的宠物床)时,我们的模型可能会对如此低的突出区域视而不见,无法找到正确的答案. 这表明,虽然注意力集中在大多数环境下提高了稳健性,但也可能使模型偏向弱信号,表明在处理不确定的视觉细节方面存在局限性.

blocks.en: Conclusion and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 结论和未来方向

blocks.en: In this work, we study attention misallocation as a potential source of hallucination in MLLMs and reformulate it as a problem of suboptimal probability mass distribution over visual regions. To address this, we propose Selective Probability Mass Concentration (sPMC), an effective weak supervision framework that directly regularizes the global structure of cross-modal attention. By encouraging attention to concentrate on semantically relevant regions and selectively tuning grounding-relevant heads, sPMC enhances MLLMs’ “visibility” while preserving the model’s inherent reasoning capabilities. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that our approach consistently enhances zero-shot performance over base models. A promising direction is to incorporate more diverse and challenging visual inputs, including synthetic data and compositional scenes. Such data could provide richer supervision and improve robustness under complex reasoning conditions.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们研究将注意力错分配作为MLLMs中幻觉的潜在来源,并将其重新表述为视觉区域中低于最佳概率质量分布的问题. 为了解决这一问题,我们提议选择概率质量浓度,这是一个有效的薄弱监督框架,直接规范跨模式关注的全球结构。 通过鼓励注意集中关注相关区域,并有选择地调整与地面有关的负责人,方案协调委员会提高了MLLMs的 " 可见度 " ,同时保留了模型固有的推理能力。 跨越多个基准的广泛试验表明,我们的做法始终比基准模型提高零射效绩。 一个有希望的方向是纳入更加多样化和更具挑战性的视觉投入,包括合成数据和组成场景。 这种数据可以在复杂的推理条件下提供更丰富的监督并增强稳健性。

blocks.en: Preliminary Experiment
blocks.zh: 初步实验

blocks.en: We conduct a preliminary analysis to better understand the role of attention heads when taking on comprehensive multimodal tasks. Two key observations are: (1) within each model, only a small subset of attention heads consistently exhibits grounding behavior, characterized by relatively concentrated attention on semantically relevant visual regions. This suggests that visual evidence aggregation is not uniformly distributed across heads, but instead localized to a few specialized components.
blocks.zh: 我们进行初步分析,以更好地了解各主管在承担全面多式联运任务时的作用。 两项关键观察是:(1)在每个模型中,只有一小部分注意力头持续地展现了基础行为,其特征是相对集中地关注与聚合相关的视觉区域. 这表明视觉证据汇总不是统一分布在头部,而是被本地化到少数专业部分.

blocks.en: (2) Second, this pattern is consistent across different model architectures and scales. Despite differences in design, we observe similar head-level behaviors, where a limited number of heads dominate grounding-related attention while others serve complementary roles such as contextual reasoning or diffusive exploring.
blocks.zh: (2) 其次,这种模式在不同模式结构和尺度之间是一致的。 尽管在设计上存在差异,但我们观察到类似的头级行为,在头级行为中,有限数量的头在地面相关关注中占据主导地位,而其他头级行为则发挥辅助作用,如背景推理或模糊探索.

blocks.en: To support these observations, we provide two illustrative visualizations. Figure 6 : Qualitative attention maps that highlights representative heads that consistently capture visual grounding across samples. Figure 7 : qualitative attention maps that demonstrates visual evidence aggregation behavior existing across different model backbones. These results collectively support our motivation in method design that grounding is an emergent yet sparse property, motivating targeted supervision rather than uniform regulation across all heads.
blocks.zh: 为了支持这些意见,我们提供了两个说明性的可视化。 图6:突出代表性头部的定性关注图,持续捕捉跨样本的目视地面. 图7:显示不同模型骨干上存在的视觉证据汇总行为的定性关注图. 这些结果共同支持了我们在方法设计方面的动机,即搁浅是一个新兴而又稀少的财产,激励有针对性地进行监督,而不是对所有领导人实行统一的监管。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Qualitative attention maps highlighting representative heads (e.g., Layer 27, head 6 and 9) that consistently capture relevant visual evidence across samples. Other head’s attention (e.g., head 6, and 14) are scattered in the image or not focusing on the relevant region.
blocks.zh: 图6:突出代表性头像的定性注意图(如第27层,第6和第9头),始终如一地捕捉跨样本的相关视觉证据. 其他头目的注意力(如头6和14)分散在画面中或者不专注于相关区域.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Qualitative attention maps demonstrating visual evidence aggregation behavior exists across different model backbones: Qwen3-VL-2B, Qwen3-VL-8B, Llama-3.2-11B-V. For various backbones, the selected heads appeared to be more concentrated on relevant regions compared to other heads.
blocks.zh: 图7:显示视觉证据聚合行为的定性关注图存在于不同的模型骨干上: Qune3-VL-2B,Qune3-VL-8B,Llama-3.2-11B-V. 对于各种骨干,选取的头部似乎比其他头部更集中于相关区域.

blocks.en: Details of Semantically Enriched Grounding Mask Generation
blocks.zh: 精密的地表面具生成细节

blocks.en: This section describes the automated pipeline generating high-fidelity segmentation masks paired with noun phrases. This process transforms raw image-text pairs from the source dataset into grounded training data through a two-stage extraction and segmentation framework.
blocks.zh: 本节描述自动管道生成高纯度分解口罩与名词短语对齐. 这个过程通过两个阶段的提取和分解框架,将原始图像文本对从源数据集转换为基础培训数据.

blocks.en: The initial stage of our pipeline involves extracting concrete, segmentable entities from complex image descriptions. Given a caption from the dataset, we employ Qwen3-4B-Instruct ( Yang et al. 2025 ) as a semantic parser. This constraint ensures semantic alignment between the text and the image while filtering out abstract concepts (e.g., love, freedom) that are not suitable to localize. The output of this stage is a set of query-ready noun phrases P = { p 1 , p 2 , … , p n } P=\{p_{1},p_{2},...,p_{n}\} , where each p i p_{i} represents a localized entity with its original modifiers (e.g., colors, sizes, or spatial attributes). Modifiers turn isolated object nouns into fully grounded, semantically rich queries, which is critical for generating accurate masks that correspond to the intended object in context.The specific prompt we used is:
blocks.zh: 我们管道的初始阶段是从复杂的图像描述中提取混凝土和可分割的实体。 根据数据集的标题,我们使用Quen3-4B-Instruct(杨等人,2025年)作为语义解析器. 这种约束在过滤不适宜本地化的抽象概念(如爱,自由)的同时,确保文本和图像之间的语义一致. 这个阶段的输出是一组可查询的名词短语 P = {p 1, p 2 ,..., p n } p=\{p_{1},p_{2},.,p_{n}\},其中每个p i_{i}i}i}代表一个具有其原始修饰符的本地实体(例如颜色,大小,或空间属性). 修饰者将孤立对象名词转化为完全基于,内容丰富的查询,这对于产生符合上下文设定对象的准确口罩至关重要. 我们使用的具体提示是:

blocks.en: Prompt Design for Mask Generation <SYSTEM PROMPT> Extract specific, individual physical objects or regions from the image description as noun or short noun phrases including key modifiers (e.g. color, size, location). Exclude categories and collections. The output must be literal substrings from the text. <USER PROMPT> Refer to this image description: {caption}
blocks.zh: 用于 Mask 生成 <SYSTEM PROMPT > 的快速设计 从图像描述中提取特定,单个的物理对象或区域作为名词或短名词短语,包括关键修饰符(如颜色,大小,位置). 不包括类别和收藏。 输出必须是文本的字面下字符串. 用户 PROMPT > 参考此图像描述 : { caption}

blocks.en: With the extracted semantic queries P P , we perform zero-shot instance segmentation to generate binary spatial masks. We utilize the Segment Anything Model 3 (SAM3) ( Carion et al. 2026 ) , passing the image I I and the extracted phrase p p as a multimodal prompt pair. For each image-query pair, the model predicts binary mask of the same resolution as the image.
blocks.zh: 使用提取的语义查询 PP, 我们进行零镜头实例分割 生成二进制空间口罩。 我们使用“任何部分”模式3(SAM3)(Carion等人,2026年),将图像I和摘录的短语p作为多模式的快速对。 对于每对图像-query配对,模型预测与图像相同的分辨率的二进制面具.

blocks.en: To refine the spatial accuracy of our generated data, we configure the SAM3 inference parameters to balance semantic recall with spatial accuracy. We apply a detection threshold τ d ​ e ​ t = 0.15 \tau_{det}=0.15 to filter out low-confidence object proposals that lack sufficient alignment with the text prompt, and a mask binarization threshold τ m ​ a ​ s ​ k = 0.5 \tau_{mask}=0.5 to project the model’s soft attention logits into discrete pixel-level assignments. This configuration allows the pipeline to capture challenging or small objects while establishing definitive decision boundaries for foreground pixels, ensuring that the resulting masks provide a sharp, unambiguous signal for downstream probability mass concentration tuning.
blocks.zh: 为了完善我们生成的数据的空间精度,我们配置了SAM3推断参数,以平衡语义回溯和空间精度. 我们使用检测阈值 \ d e t = 0.15\ tau\ det\ 0. 15 来过滤缺乏文本提示的低自信对象提案, 并使用遮罩二进制阈值 \ m s k = 0.5\ tau\ massk\ 0. 5 来将模型的软注意力记录到离散像素级别的任务中。 这种配置使管道能够捕捉具有挑战性或小的物体,同时为前方像素确定确定决定边界,确保由此产生的口罩为下游概率聚变提供尖锐,毫不含糊的信号.

blocks.en: To maintain the integrity of the training data, we implement a semantic density filter to prune low-quality or overly-generalized masks. We define a foreground ratio ρ \rho as: ρ = 1 H ⋅ W ​ ∑ x , y ℳ x , y \rho=\frac{1}{H\cdot W}\sum_{x,y}\mathcal{M}_{x,y} Where ℳ ( x , y ) ∈ { 0 , 1 } \mathcal{M}_{(x,y)}\in\{0,1\} . H H and W W represent row and column sizes of the mask. We discard any mask where ρ > 0.6 \rho>0.6 . This heuristic effectively filters out hallucinated segmentations or cases where the model fails to differentiate between a specific object and the global background.

The resulting dataset provides a dense, semantically-grounded mapping that serves as the foundation for our visual reasoning training. Samples from the curated dataset are illustrated in Figure 8 . These examples demonstrate that the generated masks are semantically well-aligned with their corresponding queries and exhibit high spatial precision, with minimal annotation noise.
blocks.zh: 由此产生的数据集提供了一个密集的、有条理的绘图,作为我们进行视觉推理培训的基础。 图8显示了整理数据集的样本。 这些例子表明,生成的口罩与其相应的查询非常吻合,并表现出高度的空间精度,极少出现注音噪音.

blocks.en: Quality Evaluation of Segmentation Masks
blocks.zh: 分块面具的质量评价

blocks.en: We conducted an AI-assisted semantic utility audit on 200 records sampled from the created dataset. For each record, a human and a blinded multimodal AI evaluator saw the original image, the target phrase, and a side-by-side visualization with the mask overlaid in translucent red; the source question and answer were withheld. The audit measures useful semantic localization for attention supervision rather than pixel-level segmentation accuracy. Imprecise boundaries, partial coverage that clearly localized the target, moderate over-coverage, and merged nearby regions were not automatically penalized. Each example was labeled Accurate, Usable, Unusable, or Unjudgeable. We release the audit artifact in the as Supplementary Media Archive. Each of the 200 records include image with segmentation mask, assessment on target visibility, target coverage, irrelevant coverage, confidence, and decision reason.
blocks.zh: 我们对从创建的数据集抽取的200个记录进行了人工辅助语义用途审计。 每一份记录中,一个人和一个蒙蔽的多式AI评价员都看到原始图像,目标短语,并用半透明红色覆盖面具的侧面可视化;源问答被扣. 审计测量了有用的语义定位,用于关注监督,而不是像素级的分区精度. 不明确的界限、目标明确的局部覆盖、中等程度的过度覆盖以及附近的合并地区不会自动受到惩罚。 每个实例都标注为准确性、可用性、不可使用性或不可判断性。 我们公布审计文物 作为补充媒体档案。 200份记录中的每一份记录都包含有分块口罩的图像、目标可见度评估、目标覆盖、不相关的覆盖、信心和决定理由。

blocks.en: Overall, at least 195/200 examples (97.5%) were determined Accurate or Usable. Excluding Unjudgeable cases, the usable-mask rate was 195/198 = 0.985 (98.5%; Wilson 95% CI [95.6%, 99.5%]). This quality is more than sufficient for the intended attention-supervision setting because the method is designed to be robust to noisy labels: masks act as weak spatial guidance, not pixel-level ground truth, and the small residual of noisy or ambiguous supervision can therefore be tolerated.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,至少确定195/200例(97.5%)准确或可用。 不包括 无法判决的案件,可用工作负担率为195/198=0.985(98.5%;Wilson 95% CI[95.6%,99.5%])。 这种质量对于预定的注意-监督设置来说就足够了,因为这种方法的设计是坚固的,以达到吵闹的标签:面具起到弱的空间引导作用,而不是像素级的地面真理,因此可以容忍吵闹或模棱两可的监督的少量残余.

blocks.en: Figure 8 and Figure 9 contain 12 examples from the evaluation: three clear Accurate masks, four imperfect but useful Usable masks, and all five Unusable/Unjudgeable cases identified by AI (human identified Unusable cases are a subset of the shown examples) for an extensive error analysis. It can be seen that the generated segmentation masks are generally quite accurate even for challenging cases. When focusing on the extremely rare error cases, the kite example is dominated by irrelevant sky; the “women”example masks a man and foreground regions; the guitar example highlights the illustrated figure rather than the intended object; the pink-bike example focuses on other bicycles; and the broad “orange items” phrase is too ambiguous for reliable judgment. These cases show the main residual risks are wrong-target or over-global masks and ambiguous phrases. We do observe that the AI evaluator is slightly stricter than the human evaluator, especially around the criteria for Accurate and Usable. However, it does not change our conclusion that the quality of the generated segmentation mask set is sufficient for sPMC training.
blocks.zh: 图8和图9载有来自评价的12个实例:三个清晰的准确口罩,四个不完美但有用的可用口罩,以及大赦国际查明的所有五个无法使用/无法判断的案件(人类识别出的无法使用的案件是所示实例的一个子集),用于广泛的错误分析. 可以看出,即使对于具有挑战性的案件,生成的分解口罩也一般相当准确. 专注极罕见的错误案例时,风筝的例子以无关紧要的天空为主;“女性”的例子掩盖了一个人和前景区域;吉他的例子突出了被说明的数字而不是预定的对象;粉红色自行车的例子着重于其他自行车;广义的“橙色物品”短语过于模糊,难以作出可靠的判断。 这些案件表明,主要的残余风险是目标错误或全球范围过大以及模棱两可。 我们确实注意到,人工智能评价员比人类评价员略为严格,特别是在准确和可用标准方面。 然而,这并没有改变我们的结论,即生成的分片口罩集的质量足以用于SPMC培训.

blocks.en: Adaptive thresholds
blocks.zh: 适应性阈值

blocks.en: Rather than employing a fixed heuristic threshold, we dynamically determine the point of diminishing returns by analyzing the distribution of head scores. For a sorted set of scores V V , we compute the optimal threshold by treating the distribution as a discrete curve and finding the point of maximum curvature relative to the curve’s secant line.

blocks.en: We use parameter-efficient LoRA tuning and keep the remaining backbone parameters frozen. For all backbones, the adapters use rank 16, LoRA alpha 16, dropout 0.1, and no bias parameters. For Qwen3-VL-2B, LoRA is applied to the query and value projections in the first 14 of 28 language layers; for Qwen3-VL-8B, it is applied to the query and key projections in the final 15 of 36 language layers. For Llama-3.2-11B-Vision, LoRA is applied to the query and key projections of the cross-attention modules across the language backbone (i.e., only blocks containing those modules are affected). These architecture-specific placements are implementation choices rather than components of our method. We train each model for one epoch in bfloat16 with AdamW, a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay 0.1, 100 warmup steps, and a two-cycle cosine schedule with hard restarts. The effective batch size is 32 (using gradient accumulation where needed), and the random seed is 42.
blocks.zh: 我们使用具有参数效率的LORA调制,并保持剩余主干参数的冻结. 对于所有的骨干,适配器使用16级,LORAα 16,淘汰0.1,没有偏差参数. 对于Qune3-VL-2B,Lora适用于28个语言层的前14个查询和数值预测;对于Qune3-VL-8B,则适用于36个语言层的最后15个查询和关键预测. 对于Llama-3.2-11B-Vision,LORA适用于跨语言主干线的交叉切入模块的查询和关键预测(即只有包含这些模块的块受到影响). 这些针对具体结构的安置是执行选择,而不是我们方法的组成部分。 我们用 AdamW 在 bfloat16 训练每个模型, 学习率为 10 - 4 10 - 4 = , 重量衰减 0.1, 100 个热身步骤, 以及 硬重启的双循环余弦表。 有效批量大小为32(必要时使用梯度累积),随机种子为42.

blocks.en: Our method is evaluated across multiple VLM benchmarks, grouped into two main categories: general vision-language understanding and visual hallucination task. 1) General vision-language understanding task assesses comprehensive multimodal capabilities such as OCR and reasoning. There three benchmarks under this category: • MMVP ( Tong et al. 2024 ) is a compact benchmark that contains 300 images-question pairs. It is designed to evaluate vision-language models on “CLIP-blind" visual features. Higher performance on MMVP indicates the MLLMs can genuinely utilize visual information rather than relying on language priors. • VisOnly (Synthetic and Real splits) ( Kamoi et al. 2025 ) evaluates MLLMs on 12 various geometric perception tasks, and reveals that base MLLMs often cannot accurately perceive basic geometric information in images. The dataset contains synthetic dataset (700 questions) and real dataset (900 questions). • V* ( Wu and Xie 2023 ) is a visual search and grounding benchmark designed to evaluate Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) on processing high-resolution images ( 2246 × 1582 2246\times 1582 average resolution) and locating small visual details ( area < 0.05 % \text{area}<0.05\% ). The dataset consists of 191 multiple-choice evaluation samples split into two core sub-tasks: attribute recognition (115 samples) and spatial relationship reasoning (76 samples). • MME ( Fu et al. 2025 ) is a large-scale evaluation suite with over 14,000 evaluation samples spanning perception and cognition tasks. It includes fine-grained subtasks such as object recognition, OCR, commonsense reasoning, and numerical understanding, providing a comprehensive assessment of multimodal capability and robustness.

blocks.en: Baseline models
blocks.zh: 基线模型

blocks.en: • Base Models. We select Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct, Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct ( Bai et al. 2025 ) , and Llama3.2-11B-Vision ( Grattafiori et al. 2024 ) as our primary backbones to ensure diversity in both model scale and architectural design. Specifically, Qwen3-VL models represent strong decoder-only self-attention architectures at different parameter scales (2B vs 8B), enabling us to analyze scaling effects on attention behavior. In contrast, Llama3.2-11B-Vision adopts a cross-attention-based design , providing a complementary paradigm for multimodal fusion. This combination allows us to comprehensively evaluate the generality of our method across distinct attention mechanisms and model capacities. • Other Baseline Models. We also consider alternative open-source MLLMs, including Qwen2-VL-72B ( Bai et al. 2023 ) , InternVL3-72B ( Zhu et al. 2025 ) , Molmo-7B-O ( Deitke et al. 2024 ) and Llama-3.2-90B ( Grattafiori et al. 2024 ) , and close-source MLLMs, including Gemini1.5-Pro ( Team et al. 2024 ) and GPT-4V. These models serve as reference points due to their leading performance on multimodal benchmarks, but are not directly comparable as they rely on larger scales (parameter size ≥ \geq 20B) and complex post-training strategies (e.g., mixed preference optimization). In contrast, our method is evaluated on smaller MLLMs (2B-8B) under controlled settings, where it achieves comparable or even superior performance. Moreover, as a lightweight and model-agnostic approach, it can be readily integrated into larger models to further enhance their performance.

blocks.en: Base Models. We select Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct, Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct ( Bai et al. 2025 ) , and Llama3.2-11B-Vision ( Grattafiori et al. 2024 ) as our primary backbones to ensure diversity in both model scale and architectural design. Specifically, Qwen3-VL models represent strong decoder-only self-attention architectures at different parameter scales (2B vs 8B), enabling us to analyze scaling effects on attention behavior. In contrast, Llama3.2-11B-Vision adopts a cross-attention-based design , providing a complementary paradigm for multimodal fusion. This combination allows us to comprehensively evaluate the generality of our method across distinct attention mechanisms and model capacities.

blocks.en: Other Baseline Models. We also consider alternative open-source MLLMs, including Qwen2-VL-72B ( Bai et al. 2023 ) , InternVL3-72B ( Zhu et al. 2025 ) , Molmo-7B-O ( Deitke et al. 2024 ) and Llama-3.2-90B ( Grattafiori et al. 2024 ) , and close-source MLLMs, including Gemini1.5-Pro ( Team et al. 2024 ) and GPT-4V.
